cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Quick yes to the garden party before the booking expires?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Let's secure the date, then count chairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the quote while you say yes. That way we won't lose the booking while you're reading it.

mechanism: A uses expert event-planning sequence corrections to obtain a yes before B can inspect guest numbers or costs.
confusable: Ordinary efficient planning answers practical questions first; A calls those questions premature in order to secure commitment before scrutiny.
comparison: Sofa alternative uses imminent delivery pressure; party alternative uses an expiring date hold and staged planning.
seedUse: Garden booking, guests and quote derive from D28-a; S03 adds exact phase distinctions to make delay of scrutiny sound competent.
